raw_text: Breaking: Mumbai Port Trust hit by cyber intrusion targeting vessel traffic management and cargo scheduling systems. Zero-day vulnerability in legacy SCADA interface exploited. Maritime traffic temporarily rerouted to JNPT. NCIIPC has issued critical alert to all major Indian ports. This is a significant critical infrastructure attack. #MumbaiPort #CyberAttack #Maritime
clean_text: Mumbai Port cyber intrusion via zero-day in legacy SCADA. Vessel traffic and cargo systems compromised. Traffic rerouted to JNPT. NCIIPC critical alert to all ports.
